verdict.rationale: Thoropass assigns control owners and lets you filter the Roadmap by owner. Evidence requests support comments, attachments and status updates, and action items organize compliance tasks. The only documented reminders, however, are policy-timeline reminders for access reviews, not renewal or expiry tracking for manual artifacts. Missing for 10: per-artifact ownership on manual evidence, due dates on evidence items, renewal reminders for manual evidence, expiry tracking, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
